critical_code_review_comments: dashFor() and resolveTarget logic duplicated verbatim in Login.jsx and Register.jsx. Minor DRY violation — extract to /app/frontend/src/lib/roles.js for future maintenance.

Login.jsx and Register.jsx still keep both an in-component `if (user) <Navigate>` guard AND a post-submit imperative navigate(). Consider consolidating; the guard alone would suffice after state updates.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 CLOSED — 10/10 flows passing. Fix in Login.jsx & Register.jsx (`const target = (from && from !== '/') ? from : dashFor(role);`) verified to correctly route guest users landing at '/' to /menu, while preserving the deep-link restore behaviour (/menu, /cart, etc.). All auth-gate, logout, OAuth-callback, and authed-hits-/login redirects work. No open bugs.
rca of the issue: N/A — issue fixed in this iteration. Previously state.from={pathname:'/'} was used as an explicit target, sending customers back to Landing. New guard `from && from !== '/'` treats root as no-destination and falls through to dashFor(role).
